svg.text: Complex Product Configurator Data Model - ER Diagram
Three-Layer Model: L1 Business Meta-Model -- L2 Business Object Instances -- L3 Configuration Runtime Instances
L1 Business Meta-Model Layer (Type / Template, defined by IT and Business)
L2 Business Object Instances Layer (Concrete Data, maintained by Product Data Architect)
ProductInstance Layer (Sellable Product Instances with Cutting Semantics)
e.g. S1110 disables cpu3/cpu4, enables cpu1/cpu2
S1110 vs S22 Product Instance Comparison
- enabled: cpu1, cpu2, md1, md2, sd1
- excluded: cpu3, cpu4, sd2, sd3, md3
- enabled: cpu2, cpu3, cpu4, sd2, sd3, md2, md3
L3 Configuration Runtime Layer (Runtime, executed by Configuration Engine)
Doc Version: v1.1 | Complex Product Configurator Data Model
